scripts.dev: bun run --filter @reservepay/core build && bun run --filter @reservepay/web dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @reservepay/core build && bun run --filter @reservepay/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @reservepay/core build && bun run --filter "*" typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter @reservepay/core build && bun run --filter "*" test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
